pieces.name: Bias binding (neckline + armholes)
pieces.cut: cut 1 strip(s) 1218 x 25 mm ON THE BIAS (45° to the grain), join end to end (total 1218 mm = edge 1198 mm + overlap), press in half, wrap the edge and trim the excess

pieces.name: Waist Tie (bel bağı)
pieces.cut: cut 2 rectangle(s) 90 x 630 mm (finished 30 x 600 mm), each ties from the side seam round to a bow at centre back

pieces.name: Shirred Bust Panel (büzgü büst panosu)
pieces.cut: cut 2 rectangle(s) 1006 x 140 mm (join to a 1953 mm flat top edge that gathers down to 976 mm), gathered shirred at the bust
